name: Himitsu Kichi de Himegoto
source:
Having become a university student, the protagonist moved to a tranquil town.

When he got used to living in a new environment, he happened to find a girl 
going deep into a mountain. Following after her out of curiosity 
he found something that looks like a building.

"I-is anyone here?"

This was the first encounter with Yuki-chan for the protagonist in her secret fort.
Since then he has played with her using toys. One of these days, he finds
a porn book hidden in her fort. It seems like Yuki-chan is interested in H things...

"I'll show you my d*ck if you were interested in those things."

The two's secret activities begin here...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE218630.html]Dlsite English[/url]]
translation:
成为一名大学生后，主角搬到了一个宁静的小镇。

当他适应了新的环境后，碰巧认识了一个女孩 
进入大山深处。出于好奇就跟着她 
他发现了一些看起来像建筑物的东西。

“我、有人在吗？”

这是主角在小由希的秘密要塞里第一次见到她。
从那时起，他就用玩具和她一起玩。其中一天，他发现
她的堡垒里藏着一本色情书。看来Yuki酱对H的东西很感兴趣……

“如果你对这些东西感兴趣的话，我会让你看看我的家伙。”

两人的秘密活动由此开始……
